sinopsis.es: Felipe se cuela a un toque y descubre que su novio Eduardo lo oculta por miedo a aceptar su homosexualidad. Entre un primer trance químico y un pogo, se liberan y desinhiben, hasta que un intento de beso amenaza con desatar violencia y sus peores miedos.
sinopsis.en: Felipe sneaks into a gig and discovers that his boyfriend Eduardo is hiding him out of fear of accepting his own homosexuality. Amid a first chemical trip and a mosh pit, they let go and lose their inhibitions, until an attempted kiss threatens to unleash violence and their deepest fears.
